summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new /services page and Service Enquiry flow. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (valid submission, empty services 400, invalid email 422, empty name/message 400, contact regression). Frontend: nav-services routes to /services (URL updates), 7 service cards render with correct names in correct order, clicking service-card-3 opens Radix dialog with 'Global Investing Discussion' preselected (aria-pressed=true), multi-select chip toggling works, client validation shows all 5 inline errors on empty submit and rejects name '12345'/email 'bad'/phone 'abc'/message 'short', valid submission succeeds with real email delivery (enquiry-success panel appears within ~2s), bottom services-general-cta preselects 'General Investing Discussion', homepage no longer has any service cards, /contact regression form still renders and works.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: server.py logger is defined AFTER it is referenced in exception handlers (logger only initialized at line 151, referenced at 88/94/125/131). Works because handlers are called lazily post-startup, but should be moved above route definitions for correctness.
Minor: ServiceEnquiryCreate does not validate phone format server-side (only client-side). Consider adding a Pydantic validator to reject clearly invalid phones (e.g. 'abc').
Minor: No server-side length validation on message (client requires >=10). Backend accepts any non-empty message.
seed_data_creation: Created a real service_enquiries doc via valid submission (name='TEST_Priya Sharma') and a TEST_ contact message during regression. Both persisted in db.service_enquiries and db.contact_messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 requested items verified passing. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_service_enquiry.py (6 tests). Real Resend emails were dispatched during testing to jnishant2028@gmail.com.
